name: Turkish Imam Bayildi
ingredients: 1 tsp paprika and ½ tsp cumin
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Score the cut side of the eggplants and rub with half the oil; roast cut-side down for 20 minutes.
Cook the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 6 minutes. Add the tomatoes, spices and half the parsley and cook for 5 minutes.
Turn the eggplants over and press a hollow into each; fill with the tomato mixture.
Add ¼ cup water to the dish, cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve with the warmed beans, parsley and lemon juice.
note: Traditionally cooked in far more oil; roasting first reduces the oil needed.
